name: corridome
description: Search and read the Corridome register of private-market firms, deals, companies and people, with the filing behind each fact, and people's business contacts on request.

interface.longDescription:
Corridome is a register of the firms that advise on, finance and arrange private-company deals: investment advisers, broker-dealers and the private-equity firms behind them. It is compiled from public filings (SEC Form ADV, 8-K exhibits, Form D) and firms' own websites, and every fact names the document it comes from.

With the Corridome plugin, ChatGPT can search that register for you. Ask who advised on a deal, which banks a sponsor works with, what a firm has sold since 2024, or who holds a title at a firm. ChatGPT answers from the record, with links to the filing and to the record on corridome.com.

What it can do: search firms by name, short name or SEC number; read a firm's funds, deals, portfolio companies and people; search deals by company, firm, role, state, type, value and year; read a deal's parties, value and source; read a company's owners and deals; and search people by name, title and firm.

Contacts on request: when people are shown, ChatGPT can also fetch their published business contacts (email, phone, LinkedIn), but only when you ask for them. Each contact opened uses one credit from your monthly allowance, the same as on corridome.com. A person already opened this month, or a contact that is only a LinkedIn profile, uses none. Every answer with contacts says how many credits were used, how many are left and when they start again.

What it can't do: it can't change your account, follow firms or export lists.

To use it, sign in with your Corridome account when ChatGPT asks.
defaultPrompt: Who bought Lifecore Biomedical, and which firms advised on the deal?
Show me Baird's deals as a seller's adviser since 2024.
Find the managing directors at Deerpath Capital, with their emails.

positive.description: Finds a deal by the company's name, with every party and role.
positive.prompt: Who bought Lifecore Biomedical, and which firms advised on the deal?
positive.expected_behavior: Webster Equity Partners agreed to buy Lifecore Biomedical, announced Sep 28, 2026, at a disclosed $664M. Morgan Stanley advised the buyer; Craig-Hallum Capital Group and Bourne Partners Securities advised the seller. Alcon Research, MidCap Financial Trust and MSD Partners are listed as lenders. The answer cites the 8-K exhibit and links the Corridome record.

positive.description: A firm's deals in one role since a given year, with sources.
positive.prompt: Show me Baird's deals as a seller's adviser since 2024, with the filing for each.
positive.tools_triggered: search_firms (query "Baird"); search_deals (firm_id bd-8-497, role "sell-side adviser", year_from 2024)
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies Robert W. Baird & Co. and lists 9 deals newest first (ONRAD Oct 2026; MISTRAS Group $866M; White Desert and Echo Charlie $61M; DZYNE Technologies $876M; and the rest), each with date, buyer, disclosed value where there is one, and the SEC filing link.

positive.description: Deals filtered by the adviser's role, state and year, with values.
positive.prompt: Which Texas firms advised sellers in 2025, and what were the disclosed values?
positive.expected_behavior: Four Texas firms on seven 2025 deals. Disclosed values: Tenoaks Energy Advisors on West Quito Draw Properties ($62.6M) and Amplify Energy's Oklahoma assets ($92.5M); Hillworth Securities on BOH Holdings' merger with South Plains Financial ($106M). Deals without a disclosed value are marked as such.

positive.description: People at a firm with their published business emails, counted against the member's monthly contact allowance.
positive.prompt: Find the managing directors at Deerpath Capital, with their email addresses.
positive.tools_triggered: search_firms (query "Deerpath"); search_people (firm_id ria-160791, title "managing director", include_contacts true)
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the 17 managing directors at Deerpath Capital Management, LP; 15 have a published business email (for example Orin Port, Head of Sponsor Coverage, and Reed Van Gorden, Head of Origination), one has only a LinkedIn profile and one has no published contact. It reports the contact credits used (15 the first time this month, none when asked again), the credits left, and the reset date (the 1st of next month).

positive.description: One firm's profile: recent deals and the banks it works with most.
positive.prompt: Tell me about Jefferies: its recent deals and the banks it works with most.
positive.expected_behavior: Describes Jefferies LLC, a New York broker-dealer, with recent deals and roles, and the banks it shares the most deals with: J.P. Morgan Securities (31), Goldman Sachs (27), Citigroup Global Markets (22), Barclays (16) and Morgan Stanley (15). Links the Corridome record. No contacts are fetched, because none were asked for.

negative.description: Asks for actions the plugin can't take: it can't send email or book meetings. Expected: nothing is sent or scheduled; ChatGPT may look the firm up and offer a draft.
negative.prompt: Email the partners at Baird and set up a call for next week.

negative.description: Unrelated to private-market firms, deals and people. Expected: Corridome is not used.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Chicago tomorrow?

negative.description: Market data the register doesn't hold. Expected: Corridome is not used.
negative.prompt: What's Apple's share price right now?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments, and it shows no prices or offers inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release. Six tools for searching and reading the Corridome register: firms, deals, companies and people, each with the filing or page it comes from. On request, people's published business contacts, counted against the member's monthly allowance.
